mike-ops: Hey team — quick question on payroll ticket #8421: terminated+rehired emp had an outstanding 401k loan that vendor offset during the migration. Vendor issued a taxable distribution 2024-05-12 and federal withholding was applied, but state withholding was missing. Is that expected and who fixes it? Link: https://payroll.example/ticket/8421
laura-peopleops: Thanks for flagging. Can you confirm emp id and exact termination/rehire dates? Also which termination reason code was used?
john-payroll: Emp 12457 — term 2024-05-10, rehire 2024-05-25. Vendor processed loan offset 2024-05-12. Withholding: federal ~22% taken, vendor didn't apply state (they only had federal opt on file). We can run an off-cycle state withholding. Do we want to?
emily-benefits: For loan offsets the distribution is reported on 1099-R by the plan vendor. If vendor didn't withhold state, the employer can withhold state on payroll with employee authorization or vendor may reissue 1099-R with state withholding. Check plan doc for treatment on short rehires — sometimes treated as continuous service, sometimes not. @laura-peopleops can you check memo from plan admin?
laura-peopleops: Filing with plan admin now. Also need to know if the distribution is eligible for rollover — employee rejoined and has new contributions. Rollover window is 60 days from distribution date; we'll confirm eligibility.
mike-ops: Employee asked if they can do a direct rollover to IRA to avoid tax. If vendor already recorded distribution, can payroll/processors still accept a rollover?
john-payroll: If vendor issued 1099-R, employee can still do a 60-day rollover to an IRA (personal action) or we can coordinate with vendor to recharacterize as a trustee-to-trustee transfer if vendor supports it. Payroll can't reverse a vendor-issued distribution, but we can process state withholding off-cycle if employee signs authorization.
benefits-bot: Reminder: plan loan offset events during vendor migrations should be escalated to Benefits Tier 2. Submit case BEN-7421 for plan admin review.
emily-benefits: Also flag: offsets >$10k may trigger taxable income/penalty if under 59.5. Benefits will prepare an explainer and checklist for payroll + employee (what forms/signatures needed, rollover steps, sign-off).
laura-peopleops: Update from plan admin: vendor missed state-withholding option on a subset of migrations and will reissue corrected 1099-R with state withholding for affected participants. Meanwhile payroll can run off-cycle state withholding with employee signed form to approximate state tax; vendor will reconcile. I'll DM the employee to collect signature.
mike-ops: Great — please CC me on the payroll off-cycle request so I can close ticket #8421. :thumbsup:
john-payroll: Will do. Planning off-cycle this Friday — need the signed authorization by EOD Thu.
mike-ops: I'll get the signed form to you today. Thanks everyone.
file_notes: thread about loan offset withholding during vendor migration for terminated + rehired employee; includes payroll and benefits coordination
